name: LOGistICAL 3
detailed_description:
LOGistICAL 3: The Ultimate Puzzle of Global Transport

Ready to tackle the world of logistics like never before? Get behind the wheel, strategize your moves, and solve intricate puzzles as you conquer cities, industries, and entire countries in LOGistICAL 3. This massive open-world strategy game is all about transporting cargo, upgrading industries, and managing a global network of roads and businesses. It’s time to put your thinking cap on—because this is no ordinary driving simulator!

What’s LOGistICAL 3 All About?

LOGistICAL 3 is the ultimate puzzle game that’s got everything—and we mean everything. It’s all about transporting different cargoes to complete cities and businesses across various states, regions, and countries. But don’t think this is a simple job of driving trucks. You’ll face challenges like roadblocks, quarantines, specialized cargo, and industries that need upgrading or building from the ground up. Every route you take is full of twists and turns, both literally and figuratively.

Each new module is a fresh adventure, filled with new puzzles to solve, roads to improve, and cargo to deliver. Think of it as a giant jigsaw puzzle—except instead of pieces, you’ve got industries, roads, and shipments to piece together for success.

What’s New and Exciting in LOGistICAL 3?

One of the coolest features in LOGistICAL 3 is the high-res satellite maps. Get a bird’s-eye view of the world, right down to the tiniest details—yes, even the house down the street. Other mapping modes let you switch up your perspective for an even more immersive experience. And with the added “Fun Facts” about towns and businesses, plus links to explore more about the real world, you’ll learn something new while you play.

Each DLC in LOGistICAL 3 is its own standalone game, focused on specific countries or states, offering unique challenges and gameplay mechanics. The first DLC, LOGistICAL 3: Kansas, sets the stage with its own set of puzzles and regional challenges. The beauty of LOGistICAL 3 is that every DLC is a deep dive into a new location, bringing fresh complexity to the game with every module.

LOGistICAL 3 vs. LOGistICAL Earth

Now, you may be wondering—how is LOGistICAL 3 different from LOGistICAL Earth? Great question! Both games use the same engine, but LOGistICAL Earth covers the whole world with a much broader approach. It’s got fewer towns and businesses within each region. LOGistICAL 3, on the other hand, zooms in on specific states or countries, delivering a more detailed experience with a richer set of challenges. For example, in LOGistICAL Earth, Kansas is just part of the broader U.S. region. But in LOGistICAL 3, Kansas is a whole world of its own!

No Need to Own Both!

Here’s the best part: LOGistICAL 3 stands on its own! You don’t need LOGistICAL Earth (or any other module) to play it. And if you already own LOGistICAL Earth, you don’t need LOGistICAL 3 to enjoy it either. It’s designed to be its own self-contained experience, making it easy for anyone to jump in and start playing.

Need Help? Get the Free Tutorials!

LOGistICAL 3 doesn’t have its own tutorial just yet, but don’t worry! There are free tutorials available to help you get started, including demos from previous LOGistICAL games like LOGistICAL 3: Earth, LOGistICAL 2: Tuvalu, and LOGistICAL 1: ABC Islands. These will teach you the ropes and get you up to speed in no time.

The Ultimate Puzzle

Think you’ve got what it takes to manage a global logistics empire? LOGistICAL 3 is a massive puzzle where every city, road, and business is a piece that must fit together perfectly. Some cities are easy to complete, but others require careful planning and smart strategy. You’ll need to manage cargo, build and upgrade industries, and use a variety of vehicles to get everything to its destination. The further you go, the more complex the logistics become, and the more creative you’ll need to get to succeed.

Tip: Boost your transports to make deliveries more efficient and unlock new opportunities. But be careful—big vehicles may be able to haul more, but they can’t go everywhere. And don’t forget about the broken transport routes that need fixing!

Loads of Achievements

LOGistICAL 3 doesn’t just keep you on your toes with its intricate gameplay—it rewards you for your progress too! Complete cities, roads, industries, contracts, regions, and states to earn in-game achievements and Steam trophies. The more you accomplish, the more recognition you get!

Ready to Deliver?

LOGistICAL 3 is more than just a game. It’s a journey of strategy, puzzles, and global logistics. Whether you’re a newcomer or a seasoned pro, there’s always a new challenge around the corner. So, get ready to plan, deliver, and solve your way to the top. After all, the world’s logistics aren’t going to sort themselves out!
